# Not Like Us
> Cited rules for avoiding recognizable AI writing and interface defaults.

Canonical: https://github.com/jtc268/not-like-us
Site: https://notlikeus.adorellc.pro
Skill: /skills/not-like-us/SKILL.md
Paste block: /manual/prompt.txt
Agent instructions: /AGENTS.md
Compact manifest: /manual/not-like-us.json
Writing rules: /manual/rules/WRITING.md
Design rules: /manual/rules/DESIGN.md
Per-tool guides: /manual/tools/{tool}/WRITING.md and /manual/tools/{tool}/DESIGN.md
Sources: /manual/data/sources.json
Rule data: /manual/data/rules.json

Priority: local brand, voice, accessibility, and design-system requirements override this repository.
Interpretation: recurring defaults are prompts to inspect, not proof that AI made an artifact.
